caption: Nforbi v. Staples Retail et al.
status: PENDING — new-hire background screening in progress via First Advantage. No adverse action yet as of Oct. 2, 2026.
defendants: Staples Retail (employer — entity named in all disclosure and authorization documents). First Advantage (CRA — P.O. Box 105292, Atlanta, GA 30348; 1.800.845.6004).
key_facts: On or about Sep. 29, 2026, Brendan Ngehsi Ngwanforbi received a conditional offer for the position of Retail Sales Supervisor at Staples, through the Fountain hiring platform (staples.fountain.com). On Sep. 29, 2026, he signed the Acknowledgment and Authorization for Background Investigation (E-SignID: 56150413, signed 9/30/2026 12:51 AM -04:00). The authorization and all disclosure documents identify the employer as 'Staples Retail' ('the Company'). The disclosures include: (1) Disclosure Regarding Background Investigation; (2) Disclosure Regarding 'Investigative Consumer Report' Background Investigation; (3) Notice Regarding Background Checks Per California Law (with ICRAA Cal. Civ. Code § 1786.22 file-inspection rights); (4) Other State Law Notices (CA/MN/OK free-copy box checked; NY Article 23-A, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA/SF Fair Chance ordinances, WA Fair Credit Reporting Act); (5) Consent to Use of Electronic Records and Signatures (signed 9/30/2026 12:51:59 AM); (6) Summary of Rights Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act. The CRA conducting the background investigation is First Advantage. As of Oct. 2, 2026, the Fountain portal shows 'New Hire Screenings In Progress' — the background check has been initiated but no results or adverse action have occurred. Prior name on file: Brendan Ngehsi Newanforbi (Dec. 11, 2016 – Jan. 1, 2022). Current address: Milpitas, CA 95035 (since Aug. 27, 2026). Prior address: Stockton, CA 95204 (May 2021 – Aug. 2026).
note: Prospective employment matter. Employer entity is 'Staples Retail' per all First Advantage disclosure documents — not 'Staples, Inc.' The parent corporate structure (Staples, Inc., privately held by Sycamore Partners since 2017) may matter for service and naming. Ripens only if a non-hire, rescission, or adverse action rests on the background report. No report has been returned yet; no adverse action has occurred.
